Usage of `prufyx check` and `prufyx prepare` for this project, as
`--project coredns --help` on each route prints it. Identity, stage and rule
coverage: `prufyx catalog cncf --project coredns`. Shared flags, exit status and
the reference text of each route: [routes.md](routes.md).

## check cncf

```text
prufyx check cncf --project coredns --coredns-corefile FILE --from 1.6.9 --to 1.7.0 or 1.9.4|1.10.1|1.11.4|1.12.4|1.13.2 --to 1.14.7 --coredns-distribution official --coredns-corefile-complete (--now RFC3339 | --knowledge-db DIR) [--coredns-corefile-digest SHA256] [--replay-report FILE] [--format human|json]
```

## prepare cncf

```text
prufyx prepare cncf --project coredns --coredns-corefile FILE --from 1.6.9 --to 1.7.0 or 1.9.4|1.10.1|1.11.4|1.12.4|1.13.2 --to 1.14.7 --coredns-distribution official --coredns-corefile-complete [--coredns-corefile-digest SHA256] [--format human|json|input]
```
